arguments.name: Anchored temporal foreground propagation with Cutie
arguments.description: Cutie-base480px propagates SAM2 union-of-people anchors refreshed every2s and reset at frozen edits. Same YOLO prompts/UI exclusions; no detector replacement. Compare stateless SAM2 and held-anchor control on independent masks/background color.
